content.title: Complete guest checkout on a phone with a valid weekday delivery date
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can complete the end-to-end bouquet checkout as a guest on a phone-sized web surface, choose a non-Sunday delivery date, and reach an order confirmation that includes an order number.
content.technique_notes: Derived from covering_array strength=3 over surface × checkout_mode × delivery_date because money risk applied; the tool returned two unique combinations and this scenario covers the valid non-Sunday combination. Applied the stateful-flow and web-form profiles because the source described an end-to-end checkout flow with date selection and completion on a phone. dedupe_candidates found no duplicate candidate, and graph_search_similar_batch found no existing scenario-level reuse candidate.
